name: wayfairs-php-banking
description: Installable Wayfairs PHP banking script (PHP 8.2+, SQLite preview, MySQL hosting). No npm dependencies; npm scripts exist only so Julie can launch the PHP dev server.

scripts.dev: WAYFAIRS_BASE_PATH=${WAYFAIRS_BASE_PATH-/project/wayfairs} php -d expose_php=0 -d display_errors=0 -d log_errors=1 -S 127.0.0.1:${PORT:-4100} -t public public/router.php
